name: Music In Worship
overview: Scripture reveals that music is an essential and joyful expression of worship to the LORD, inviting believers to sing praises with gladness and skillful instruments. The Psalms encourage making a joyful noise and singing new songs to honor God as the rock of salvation, reflecting a heart redeemed by Him. Worship through music includes not only singing but also dancing and playing instruments like the timbrel and harp, demonstrating a full-bodied celebration of God's name.
